2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Postherpetic Neuralgia ( 2.1 ) Dose can be titrated up as needed to a dose of 3600 mg/day Day 1: Single 600 mg dose Day 2: 1200 mg/day (i.e., 600 mg two times a day ) Day 3: 1800 mg/day (i.e., 600 mg three times a day ) Epilepsy with Partial Onset Seizures ( 2.2 ) Patients 12 years of age and older: starting dose is 600 mg three times daily; may be titrated up to 1200 mg three times daily Patients 3 to 11 years of age: starting dose range is 10 to 30 mg/kg/day, given in three divided doses; recommended dose in patients 3 to 4 years of age is 80 mg/kg/day, given in three divided doses; the recommended dose in patients 5 to 11 years of age is 25 to 70 mg/kg/day, given in three divided doses. The recommended dose is reached by upward titration over a period of approximately 3 days Dose should be adjusted in patients with reduced renal function ( 2.3 , 2.4 ) 2.1 Dosage for Postherpetic Neuralgia In adults with postherpetic neuralgia, gabapentin may be initiated on Day 1 as a single 600 mg dose, on Day 2 as 1200 mg/day (600 mg two times a day), and on Day 3 as 1800 mg/day (600 mg three times a day). The dose can subsequently be titrated up as needed for pain relief to a dose of 3600 mg/day (1200 mg three times a day). In clinical studies, efficacy was demonstrated over a range of doses from 3600 mg/day to 7200 mg/day with comparable effects across the dose range; however, in these clinical studies, the additional benefit of using doses greater than 3600 mg/day was not demonstrated. 2.2 Dosage for Epilepsy with Partial Onset Seizures Patients 12 years of age and above The starting dose is 600 mg three times a day. The recommended maintenance dose of gabapentin is 600 mg to 1200 mg three times a day. Dosages up to 4800 mg/day have been well tolerated in long-term clinical studies. Doses of 7200 mg/day have also been administered to a small number of patients for a relatively short duration, and have been well tolerated. Administer gabapentin three times a day using 1200 mg or 1600 mg tablets. The maximum time between doses should not exceed 12 hours. Pediatric Patients Age 3 to 11 years The starting dose range is 20 mg/kg/day to 30 mg/kg/day, given in three divided doses, and the recommended maintenance dose reached by upward titration over a period of approximately 3 days.
